name: superpowers-flow
description: Live progress for superpowers plan runs: a bar above the prompt with a session row (turn, speed, cost, cache, context), an agents panel with model, steps, context, cost and time, and five tiered sp-* workers (Fable / Opus at set efforts) that superpowers dispatches instead of general-purpose. Speed profiles (thorough, balanced, fast) over per-task review, parallel slices, batching and runners (subagent, worktree, headless session per slice, shown in the panel); roles (coder, reviewer, final reviewer) and each tier's model and effort are settings. Adapted from savvy-flow, savvy-progress and session-band.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

notify.title: Push notifications
notify.description: off: none; milestones: a notification (or a toast) when a task is accepted, a worker fails, or the run finishes. Reaches the phone over Remote Control when Push when Claude decides is on in /config.

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: tier: when an sp-* worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

profile.title: Speed profile
profile.description: thorough: superpowers as it ships; balanced: one reviewer per task, independent slices in parallel worktrees, small tasks batched, targeted tests; fast: as balanced with no per-task reviewers, only the final review. Each setting below left at profile follows it.

taskReview.title: Task reviews
taskReview.description: each: spec review then quality review after every task; combined: one reviewer per task for both; final: no per-task reviewers, only the final whole-branch review. profile: as the speed profile says.

parallel.title: Parallel tasks
parallel.description: off: one task at a time; independent: tasks (or slices) whose dependencies are done run at once. profile: as the speed profile says.

batchTasks.title: Batch small tasks
batchTasks.description: off: one implementer per task; small: consecutive mechanical tasks go to one implementer. profile: as the speed profile says.

reReview.title: Re-review after fixes
reReview.description: always: a reviewer checks every fix; self: Claude checks small, local fixes itself. profile: as the speed profile says.

testScope.title: Tests per task
testScope.description: full: the whole suite after each task; targeted: each task's own tests, the full suite once before the final review. profile: as the speed profile says.

runner.title: Runner
runner.description: subagent: workers in this session, one folder; worktree: workers in this session, one git worktree and branch per slice, merged back; session: one headless Claude Code session per slice in its worktree, shown in the panel. profile: as the speed profile says (never session).

coderTier.title: Coder tier
coderTier.description: The worker that implements each task and its fix rounds. auto: the skill picks by task difficulty.

reviewerTier.title: Reviewer tier
reviewerTier.description: The worker that reviews each task and re-reviews its fixes. auto: as the speed profile says (fast: light), else scaled to the diff.

finalReviewTier.title: Final reviewer tier
finalReviewTier.description: The worker for the whole-branch review at the end. auto: as the speed profile says (balanced and fast: careful), else sp-fable.

lightModel.title: sp-light model
lightModel.description: default: opus, as the agent file says.

lightEffort.title: sp-light effort
lightEffort.description: default: low. Applies where the model supports effort.

mediumModel.title: sp-medium model
mediumModel.description: default: opus, as the agent file says.

mediumEffort.title: sp-medium effort
mediumEffort.description: default: medium. Applies where the model supports effort.

carefulModel.title: sp-careful model
carefulModel.description: default: opus, as the agent file says.

carefulEffort.title: sp-careful effort
carefulEffort.description: default: high. Applies where the model supports effort.

heavyModel.title: sp-heavy model
heavyModel.description: default: opus, as the agent file says.

heavyEffort.title: sp-heavy effort
heavyEffort.description: default: xhigh. Applies where the model supports effort.

fableModel.title: sp-fable model
fableModel.description: default: fable, as the agent file says.

fableEffort.title: sp-fable effort
fableEffort.description: default: high. Applies where the model supports effort.
